name: Four-Operator FM Styles
author: Freek van Gool
description: Tunes for Four-Operator FM by music style: synthwave, electro, pop, chiptune, jazz & soul, ambient, cinematic, techno & house, drum & bass, hip-hop & lo-fi and funk & disco. Six or seven sounds per style: basses, leads, pads, keys, plucks, chords and textures.
